items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: My brother-in-law, Gaudet. Mm-hmm. He was a leader too? Leader and manager. Yeah, leader and manager. He took care of everything.

ctx.x: That was the band. See, we made up that band and started playing among ourselves. And then when we got where we could play enough to go out and play, we named it the Peerless Band.

And who was the manager? Huh? Who was the manager? My brother-in-law, Gaudet. Mm-hmm. He was a leader too? Leader and manager. Yeah, leader and manager. He took care of everything. I never did get down, uh, why they called you Bird. That's another thing I wanted to ask you about.
Well, I was just a nickname, uh, Filipino sailor started to call me when I was in the Navy.
